visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short beard, wearing a black baseball cap, a black t-shirt, and a navy blazer over blue jeans, stands in a brightly lit modern living room. He points aggressively at the camera with his right hand, expressing confidence and directness. (2) The scene shifts to the man standing in front of a dark pegboard wall filled with various power tools, including drills and blowers. He gestures broadly with his hands as he speaks to the camera. (3) A smartphone screen overlay appears, showing a vertical video of the man within the phone's frame. A hand is seen interacting with the screen, scrolling through short videos. (4) The man appears in front of a dark, smoky background, looking intensely into the lens. The shot then cuts back to the living room setting where he continues his explanation. (5) A close-up B-roll sequence shows a white mirrorless camera mounted on a tripod on a wooden table. Hands are seen adjusting the camera's screen and lens. (6) Back in the living room, the man holds up his hand in an 'OK' sign while speaking. He wears a silver chain around his neck and a black wristband. (7) The man is shown against a bright green screen background. A recording UI overlay with a red 'REC' dot and timecode appears on the frame. (8) He is then superimposed over a vibrant background of a traditional Chinese temple. Large red and black stylized graphic text overlays appear on the left side. (9) A screen recording of the Shopee mobile app is shown. It displays the 'Shopee Video' interface with multiple vertical videos and then navigates to the 'My Wallet' and 'Affiliate Program' sections. (10) Returning to the living room, the man demonstrates using his phone to film himself holding a yellow power drill and then a stainless steel water bottle. (11) A screen recording of a Shopee product listing page shows various insulated tumblers and cups with their prices and an 'Add to Cart' button. (12) The man stands in the living room holding a yellow tape measure, pointing it towards the camera. A final text overlay appears on screen displaying a referral code.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A confident male voice delivers a high-energy monologue at a fast pace with medium-low pitch. A modern electronic hip-hop BGM with a strong, syncopated drum beat and bright synth pads plays underneath. The acoustic environment is very clean, resembling a studio recording. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition. The vocal tone becomes more challenging and assertive. Subtle digital clicking sound effects are heard, simulating phone screen interactions. The BGM remains consistent in energy. (3) A brief comedic exchange occurs between the main speaker and an off-camera male voice with a lighter, slightly skeptical tone. This interaction is natural and clear. (4) The BGM swells slightly in volume during a transitional shout, then ducks back under the primary narration. The speaker's delivery becomes more instructional and explanatory, maintaining high clarity and enthusiasm. (5) Digital 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects highlight the demonstration of the app features. The audio track ends with a final clear delivery of a referral code over the fading music bed.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Demonstration -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Shopee's short video affiliate program as a legitimate and effective way for content creators of all sizes to monetize their influence. By contrasting 'traditional' high-effort video production with the simplicity of product reviews on Shopee, the creator encourages viewers to join the program using his referral code.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of Shopee short videos, demonstration of the app's affiliate program interface, and provision of a personal referral code.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-arousal social-media editing style with frequent cuts and text overlays to maintain engagement while delivering promotional information.
